title: Hitachi Energy expands global investments as AI strains power grids
key_facts: CNA's Priyata Brajabasi interviewed Hitachi Energy CEO Andreas Schierenbeck at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi.
Topics: investments in China and India and the AI boom straining global power grids.
Major global energy players are diversifying and de-risking from one region or supplier.
quote_evidence: CNA's Priyata Brajabasi spoke to Hitachi Energy CEO Andreas Schierenbeck on the sidelines of the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi about its investments in China and India, and how the artificial intelligence boom is straining global power grids.
why_it_matters_hint: AI demand is straining power grids.
